name: Implementation Profile: Geometry extent
abstract: Implementation Profile of the operation Geometry extent, whose meaning is its activity type (activityType): the signature of the Generic Profile Unary geometry operation, bound to data exchange formats.
description:
Implementation Profile: **Geometry extent**.

> Implementation Profile of the operation Geometry extent, whose meaning is its activity type (activityType): the signature of the Generic Profile Unary geometry operation, bound to data exchange formats.

## Activity type

The meaning of the operation -- its definition, the standards that define it and its illustration --
is the activity type [`generic-profiles.activity-type.geometry-extent`](../../activity-type/geometry-extent/), to which this
profile points with `activityType` (decisions D3 and D4).

## Signature and representations

The signature of the Generic Profile [Unary geometry operation](../../generic-profile/unary-geometry-operation/), with each data-carrying
input and output bound to a representation of the
[`bblocks-data-formats`](https://github.com/GeoLabs/bblocks-data-formats) register (Table 21 Data
format, D; decision D6):

| Role | Data type | Representation |
|---|---|---|
| input `geometry` | `geometry` | [`geometry-gml`](https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/data-formats/representation/geometry-gml) (Geometry as GML) |
| output `result` | `surface` | [`surface-gml`](https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/data-formats/representation/surface-gml) (Surface as GML) |

The representations are a minimal default: a deployment may support more formats (OGC 14-065 WPS
2.0.2 §7.5.4 Table 21, footnote d).

## Source

Three sources, at different levels -- the abstract semantics, the SQL binding, and the concrete
tool this testbed actually runs:

- [OGC 06-103r4 Simple Feature Access - Part 1: Common Architecture](https://www.ogc.org/standards/sfa/)
  -- `Geometry::Envelope()`, the abstract operation (this is what
  [its Concept](../../concept/vector-geometry-processing/) and
  [Generic Profile](../../generic-profile/geometry-extent/) are grounded in too).
- ISO/IEC 13249-3:2016 *SQL multimedia and application packages -- Part 3: Spatial*, `ST_Envelope`
  -- the same operation bound to SQL, the same way SQL/MM grounds every other vector Implementation
  Profile in this register.
- [SAGA GIS -- Get Shapes Extents](https://saga-gis.sourceforge.io/saga_tool_doc/7.3.0/shapes_tools_19.html)
  -- the concrete software binding the Geonovum testbed actually runs,
  [`SAGA.shapes_tools.19`](https://host1.tb.geonovum.geolabs.fr/ogc-api/processes/SAGA.shapes_tools.19)
  ("Get Shapes Extents"): takes a shapes layer (`SHAPES`) and returns its extent (`EXTENTS`), both
  as `text/xml`/KML/`object` -- a vector geometry, not four plain numbers, the same shape this
  Implementation Profile declares. Unlike the vector predicates/operations above (SQL/MM-bound),
  this one is SAGA-bound: this testbed has no SQL/MM `ST_Envelope` process of its own, only this
  SAGA tool.

## Data formats

`geometry`, `result`: GML -- the register's minimal default (Table 21, D: Declare), consistent
with every other vector Implementation Profile in this register. `SAGA.shapes_tools.19`'s own
`SHAPES`/`EXTENTS` additionally expose KML and a generic `object` encoding; GML is kept as this
tier's minimal baseline (Per [OGC 14-065 WPS 2.0.2 §7.5.4 Table 21](https://docs.ogc.org/is/14-065/14-065.html#32),
a specific deployment may *Extend* this default, footnote d).

## Relations

- `refinesGenericProfile`: [`generic-profiles.generic-profile.unary-geometry-operation`](../../generic-profile/unary-geometry-operation/)
- `activityType`: [`generic-profiles.activity-type.geometry-extent`](../../activity-type/geometry-extent/)

## Register position

Third tier of the four-tier model (OGC 14-065 WPS 2.0.2 §7.5): Concept -> Generic Profile ->
**Implementation Profile** -> Implementation (instance level). The fourth tier is not part of
this register: see [`ospd.process-profiles.vector.geometry-extent`](https://github.com/GeoLabs/bblocks-process-profiles/tree/master/_sources/vector/geometry-extent)
in `bblocks-process-profiles` -- a real process of the ZOO-Project Geonovum testbed
(<https://host1.tb.geonovum.geolabs.fr/ogc-api/processes/SAGA.shapes_tools.19>).

That process names this profile with `implementsProfile`. Tools, hosts and testbeds are
recorded there; this item carries none as keyword or source (decision D4). The sections
above keep the tools and testbed that its defaults were grounded in.

## Changes

A proposal, amended in place on 2026-11-09 (`gp:amendmentAction`):

- `meaning-2026-11-09`, substantive
- `operation-sources-2026-11-09`, clarifying
- `representation-2026-11-09`, substantive
- `tools-2026-11-09`, clarifying
- `sections-restored-2026-11-09`, clarifying
